409110103.text: Okay, so... I'm sorry about this, but... there's something I really need your help with.

409110104.text: As you know, I've never made much progress in my alchemical studies...

409110105.text: Well, I've realized that I can't keep trying the same things over and over again. Clearly, that approach is getting me nowhere.

409110106.text: So, I decided I'd change focus. Take a fresh approach. Attempt something that's not been done before...

409110108.text: There's nothing particularly new about bio-alchemy. There are already people researching that.

409110111.text: Do you know what the most important factor in alchemy is? It's the elements.

409110112.text: For a number of reasons, alchemy is mostly performed using items infused with elemental energy, rather than pure elemental energy itself.

409110113.text: Naturally, this introduces impurities into the transmutation process, making the elemental reactions less effective...

409110114.text: To compensate, we must use larger quantities of elemental materials. Even then, we still need to be very hands-on during the transmutation process, as the impurities can easily ruin the outcome.

409110115.text: Unfortunately, this all creates extra costs for those who wish to perform alchemy without using Visions.

409110116.text: The biggest issue is that items infused with elemental energy do not come cheap.

409110117.text: The bill for the average transmutation is more astonishing than the fruits of our labor...

409110118.text: *sigh* Maybe this is why I've never made any tangible progress. The barrier to entry is just too high...

409110119.text: I don't have a Vision, either.

409110120.text: True... But I hear you can still manipulate elemental energy, correct?

409110123.text: Here's the thing: I've come up with a new kind of alchemical furnace which I call the <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Crucible</color>. The idea behind it is...

409110124.text: Well, basically, it's a vessel that can hold pure elemental energy and generate elemental reactions.

409110125.text: With any luck, the Elemental Crucible will be the thing that takes my alchemical skills to the next level...

409110126.text: Everything is set up and ready to go. All I'm missing now is someone with the ability to actually move the pure elemental energy around.

409110127.text: If you're willing to help out, please meet me at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Thousand Winds Temple</color>. That's where I had some people set everything up.

409110128.text: I really hope this will be my big breakthrough in alchemy...

409110110.text: You mean study the alchemical arts of the ancients? No, that's not something I'd be able to get involved in...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Thousand Winds Temple

409110301.text: There you are. So, here it is — the <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Crucible</color>.

409110302.text: Let's fire it up and see if it works.

409110401.text: Just need to activate it a few more times...

409110402.text: Traveler! Just who I wanted to see. Do you remember that Elemental Crucible I made?

409110403.text: After you activated it, I was able to gather a fair bit of data from the sidelines.

409110404.text: Most importantly, I was able to determine its reliability.

409110405.text: With such reliable apparatus, we will be able to perform even more experiments from now on.

409110406.text: If you're willing to help, Traveler, could you help me activate the Elemental Crucible once more?

409110410.text: The more the merrier, of course. For a Vision-less alchemist like myself, these brute-force measures are the only way I can do research...

409110411.text: So please help me activate the Elemental Crucible again. I'll be in your debt, Traveler.
